educationalGoal:
This course is designed to achieve the learning and education goal of the information design fundamentals in the Department of Management Information.
Its purpose is to train students who have a fundamental level of knowledge and skills in information technology on the user side. The topics are essentially those covered on the IT passport test, as indicated by the keywords shown here.
advice:
This course is designed to achieve the Department of Management Information Systems’ learning and educational objective of developing foundational competencies in Information Design.
The course aims to cultivate students who possess fundamental knowledge and skills related to AI, Digital Transformation (DX), and Data Science. Among the learning components of the Mathematics, Data Science, and AI Education Program, students will primarily study the content indicated by key terms while also deepening their understanding of the specialized fields within the Department of Management Information Systems.
As foundational knowledge of AI, students will learn the definition of AI, societal changes brought about by AI, the utilization of data in society, and application domains of AI.
Regarding Data and AI technologies, students will study methods of data utilization, ethics related to data, and security issues concerning data and AI.
In addition, students will learn the fundamentals of statistics and mathematics, algorithms, programming, and practical data utilization.
Students are required to prepare a report on applications of AI.

requiredKnowledge: Students should enroll in this course only after thoroughly understanding the content of the first-year spring semester courses Introduction to Data Science and Data Analytics Basic

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course is designed to achieve the Department of Management Information Systems’ learning and educational objective of developing foundational competencies in Information Design.
The course aims to cultivate students who possess fundamental knowledge and skills related to AI, Digital Transformation (DX), and Data Science. Among the learning components of the Mathematics, Data Science, and AI Education Program, students will primarily study the content indicated by key terms while also deepening their understanding of the specialized fields within the Department of Management Information Systems.
As foundational knowledge of AI, students will learn the definition of AI, societal changes brought about by AI, the utilization of data in society, and application domains of AI.
Regarding Data and AI technologies, students will study methods of data utilization, ethics related to data, and security issues concerning data and AI.
In addition, students will learn the fundamentals of statistics and mathematics, algorithms, programming, and practical data utilization.
Students are required to prepare a report on applications of AI.
